product.name: Midship AI Platform for SOX Testing
product.description: An AI platform that automates SOX control testing by following audit plans, performing tests, and generating fully documented work papers.

product.name: Midship Document Parsing and Classification
product.description: A service that parses, classifies, and matches uploaded documents to relevant audit samples for control testing.

product.description: An Excel add-in that enables auditors to review and interact with AI-generated work papers directly within Excel spreadsheets.

product.name: Midship Test Builder
product.description: A tool to define and run custom control tests on audit samples using AI agents that execute and document the tests.
